title: Protocol to assess RNA-RNA interactions in situ using an RNA-proximity ligation assay
protocol: Permeabilize cells by adding 500 μL of PLA Permeabilization Buffer to each well containing a coverslip and incubate for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate PLA Permeabilization Buffer.
Block cells using 500 μL of PLA Blocking Buffer per well containing a coverslip at 37°C for 1 hour.
Dilute an aliquot of the probe stock solution (50 μM) to 5 μM using RNase-free H2O in an RNase-free, 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 1 μL of Priming probe and 1 μL Non-Priming probe to 48 μL of PLA Blocking Buffer for each coverslip.
Mix the probe mixture well by pipetting gently up and down.
Fold a clean paper towel into a square fitting within a 10 cm² tissue culture dish.
Soak the paper towel thoroughly with dH₂O and place inside the tissue culture dish.
Cut a piece of parafilm such that it fits within the paper towel square.
Pipette the prepared 50 μL PLA probe mixture onto the parafilm to form a contained droplet.
Use flat forceps to lift the coverslip off the bottom of the well at the edges.
Gently place the coverslip onto the PLA probe mixture such that cells are in contact with the liquid.
Seal the chamber with parafilm.
Incubate at 37°C for 12–18 h.
Introduce PLA connectors into cells after PLA probe hybridization.
Remove coverslip from the hybridization chamber using forceps and place it in a 24-well plate with cells facing up.
Wash wells 3× with 1X DPBS prior to replacing the coverslip.
Add 500 μL 1X DPBS to the wells before adding the coverslip.
Ensure the coverslip is securely placed on the bottom of the well and not floating in the 1X DPBS.
Wash wells 3× with 1X DPBS using gentle rocking agitation for 5 min each wash.
Prepare ligation master mix immediately before placing it onto the coverslip.
Mix ligation master mix quickly by inverting the tube 3–4 times and/or pipetting up and down.
Pipette 200 μL of ligation master mix dropwise across each coverslip to ensure full coverage.
Draw up and redistribute any pooled liquid until the entire coverslip is covered with the ligation master mix.
Replace plate lid and incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Aspirate ligation master mix and discard.
Wash coverslips 3 times with 1X DPBS, gently rocking for 5 minutes each wash.
Mix RCA master mix by inverting 3–4 times and/or pipetting up and down.
Pipette 250 μL of RCA master mix to each coverslip.
Replace plate lid and cover with aluminum foil to protect from light.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour and 40 minutes.
Visualize the Cy5-conjugated probe bound to the RCA amplicon using confocal microscopy.
Aspirate RCA master mix and discard.
Prepare Hoechst working solution by diluting 5 mg/mL Hoechst stock 1:1000 in 500 μL 1X DPBS/coverslip.
Add 500 μL Hoechst working solution to each coverslip.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C with gentle rocking agitation for 15 min.
Aspirate Hoechst and discard.
Wash coverslips 3× with 1X DPBS, agitating gently for 5 min per wash.
Mount the coverslip onto a microscope slide.
Pipette approximately 10 μL of Vectashield mounting media per coverslip onto the slide(s).
Lift the coverslip from the bottom of the well using forceps.
Gently dab the bottom edge of the coverslip onto a Kim-Wipe to remove excess 1X DPBS.
Place the coverslip at a 45° angle such that the cells are facing towards the Vectashield.
Allow the coverslip to drop onto the Vectashield with a swift motion.
(Optional) Seal coverslips with clear nail polish.
Let slides cure at 20°C–25°C for 2 h.
